agentBotsBusyTip: Working on a task; new messages wait until it finishes
agentBotsDraftHint: The AI only drafted this: nothing exists until you confirm. Tick each high-privilege tool you allow.
agentBotsDraftNeedsApproval: Not every high-privilege tool is ticked; tick all of them before creating.
agentBotsDraftCwdInvalid: The workspace is invalid (missing folder or not an absolute path); fix the draft's workspace in the device center first.
agentBotsDraftBusy: The Bot is running a task; try again once it finishes.
agentBotsDraftMissing: This draft expired or was already handled; refresh and draft again.
agentBotsCreatePlaceholder: Describe it in one sentence, e.g. a read-only backend helper that reviews PRs
agentBotsManageTip: Manage Bot identity and permissions in the device center (edit in place from the sidebar too)
agentBotsMenuNewChatTip: Clicking a row returns to the same chat; this starts a fresh one and keeps the old record
agentBotsMenuReferenceTip: Insert this Bot as an @ target in the composer
agentBotsMenuHistoryTip: Open earlier private chats (the default opens the latest)
agentBotsRevisePlaceholder: Suggest changes for AI to regenerate…
